item.title: Democrat and Republican Clubs Start Semester with Community and Conversation
item.description: Pepperdine’s College Democrats and College Republicans chapters began the semester focusing on political dialogue and civic duty. Despite differing political views, both clubs have a commitment to building community across the political spectrum. item.title: Rave: Why Pepperdine Needs a Football Team
item.description: One of the strongest symbols of school spirit at a university is its football team. Pepperdine should bring football back to Malibu. The post Rave: Why Pepperdine Needs a Football Team appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Rant: Having a Football Team is Pointless
item.description: A hot topic that is usually on students' minds is why does Pepperdine not have a football team? However, there is no need for a Waves football team. The post Rant: Having a Football Team is Pointless appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Men’s Golf Dominates the Southwestern Invitational
item.description: Pepperdine Men's Golf took home the win at the Southwestern Invitational Jan. 26-28 at North Ranch Country Club in Westlake Village, Calif. The Waves took an early lead in day one, finishing seven under and holding the lead for the rest of the tournament to ultimately finish 11 under total. The post Men’s Golf Dominates the Southwestern Invitational appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Women’s Basketball Sees Most Wins Since 2019-20
item.description: Despite their being eight games left in the regular season, Pepperdine Women's Basketball has already won their most amount of games in a season since the 2019-20 season.
